{{Image}}
A '''docking tube''', '''boarding tube''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> '''cofferdam''', or '''pressure tunnel''' was a temporary, pressure sealed enclosure used to connect a starship in dry dock. Cofferdams were also used to connect [[Starship/Legends|starships]] with mismatched [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]]. The device itself was a flexible, ribbed tube that could attach to a surface with chemical, magnetic, mechanical, or negative pressure means. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] equivalent was the [[oqa membrane]].
